name: CyrilXBT
text:
Holy sh*t this is F*cking dangerous 

RUNNING FABLE 5, KIMI K3, AND GROK 4.5 INSIDE CODEX IS NOW ONE NPM INSTALL AWAY.

The tool is opencodex, a lightweight local proxy that translates Codex's own API format into whatever provider you actually want underneath it.

Same Codex workflow. Different brain, picked per session.

Setup is genuinely simple.

npm install -g @bitkyc08/opencodex
ocx init to add a provider
ocx start to run the proxy

From there, Codex routes through it automatically, streaming, tool calls, images, all working in both directions.

It also works with Claude Code directly, auto-context up to 1M tokens, sub-agents included.

Bookmark this before you lose the setup steps.
